description: VoxAI Competitive Benchmark Dataset — 20 prompts across 10 categories

prompts.title: Project Management SaaS
prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for ProjectFlow, a project management SaaS for remote engineering teams. Features: Kanban boards, sprint planning, Slack integration, GitHub sync, and real-time collaboration. Target: CTOs and engineering managers at 10-500 person companies. Pricing starts at $12/seat/month.

prompts.title: Customer Analytics Platform
prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for Segment Analytics, a B2B customer data and analytics platform. Features: event tracking, user segmentation, funnel analysis, A/B testing, and no-code dashboards. Target: product managers and growth teams. Enterprise pricing from $500/month.

prompts.title: AI Writing Assistant
prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for Quill AI, an AI-powered writing assistant for content creators, marketers, and bloggers. Features: long-form generation, tone adjustment, SEO optimization, multi-language support, and brand voice training. Free tier with 5,000 words/month, Pro at $19/month.

prompts.title: AI Image Generation Tool
prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for Render.ai, an AI image and video generation platform for designers and creative agencies. Features: text-to-image, image editing, style transfer, batch generation, and API access. Targets professional designers. $49/month for 500 credits.

prompts.title: Personal Finance Tracker
prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for WealthPath, a personal finance and budgeting app. Features: automatic bank sync, spending categorization, investment tracking, savings goals, and bill reminders. Target: millennials and Gen-Z. Free with premium at $9.99/month.

prompts.title: B2B Payment Processing Platform
prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for PayBridge, a B2B payment infrastructure for SaaS companies. Features: subscription billing, invoice management, multi-currency, instant payouts, Stripe-compatible API, and fraud detection. Target: Series A+ SaaS startups. Custom enterprise pricing.

prompts.title: Digital Marketing Agency
prompts.prompt: Build a website for GrowthLab, a digital marketing and growth agency specializing in B2B SaaS companies. Services: SEO, paid ads, content marketing, email campaigns, and conversion optimization. 10+ years experience, 150+ clients, average 3x ROI improvement.

prompts.title: Creative Design Studio
prompts.prompt: Build a portfolio website for Prism Studio, a creative design and branding agency. Services: brand identity, product design, motion graphics, and web design. Portfolio includes Fortune 500 clients. Awards: Awwwards, FWA, D&AD. Minimal, typographic aesthetic.

prompts.title: Developer Productivity Tool
prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for CodeSync, an AI-powered developer workflow tool. Features: automated PR reviews, code explanation, refactoring suggestions, test generation, and CI/CD integration. Early access, waitlist model. Target: individual developers and engineering teams.

prompts.title: Remote Team Collaboration App
prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for Orbit, a async-first collaboration app for globally distributed teams. Features: video messages, shared workspaces, timezone awareness, meeting summaries, and team rituals. Seed stage startup. Freemium model, $8/user/month for teams.

prompts.title: Sales Analytics Dashboard
prompts.prompt: Build a SaaS product page for RevenueIQ, a sales analytics and forecasting dashboard for B2B revenue teams. Features: pipeline visualization, deal tracking, quota attainment, forecast models, and CRM sync. Target: VP Sales and Revenue Operations. $299/seat/month.

prompts.title: Admin CRM Dashboard
prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for AdminPro, an all-in-one CRM and admin dashboard platform for SMBs. Features: contact management, email sequences, task automation, reporting, and mobile app. Target: sales teams of 5-50. $29/month flat for up to 10 users.

prompts.title: Developer Portfolio
prompts.prompt: Build a personal portfolio website for Alex Chen, a full-stack engineer with 6 years of experience in React, Node.js, and cloud infrastructure. Highlights: 3 open-source projects (10k+ GitHub stars), ex-Google, ex-Stripe. Seeking founding engineer roles.

prompts.title: UX Designer Portfolio
prompts.prompt: Build a portfolio website for Maya Patel, a senior UX/product designer specializing in fintech and enterprise software. 8 years experience. Clients include Stripe, Plaid, and Brex. Focus on case studies with measurable business impact.

prompts.title: Telemedicine Platform
prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for MediConnect, a telemedicine platform connecting patients with licensed physicians. Features: video consultations, prescription delivery, lab results, specialist referrals, and 24/7 availability. Accepts most major insurance. HIPAA compliant.

prompts.title: Mental Health App
prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for Calm Mind, a mental health and therapy app. Features: licensed therapist matching, guided meditation, mood tracking, CBT exercises, and crisis support. HIPAA compliant. $89/month for unlimited therapy access.

prompts.title: Online Fashion Store
prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for Récolte, a sustainable luxury fashion brand. Features: curated seasonal collections, size inclusivity, carbon-neutral shipping, and sustainable materials. Target: conscious consumers, 25-45. Price range $150-$800 per item.

prompts.title: Specialty Food Marketplace
prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for Harvest Table, a curated specialty food marketplace connecting small artisan producers with consumers. Features: weekly boxes, producer stories, dietary filters, gift subscriptions, and next-day delivery. Starting at $49/box.

prompts.title: Fine Dining Restaurant
prompts.prompt: Build a website for Élan, a Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant in San Francisco. Chef-driven seasonal menu with California-French cuisine. Features: reservations (OpenTable), private dining, wine cellar, and chef's tasting menu at $195/person. Minimalist luxury aesthetic.

prompts.title: Fast-Casual Restaurant with Online Ordering
prompts.prompt: Build a website for Bowl & Branch, a fast-casual healthy bowl restaurant chain with 12 locations in NYC. Features: online ordering, customizable bowls, loyalty rewards, catering for offices, and nutritional info. Bold, fresh visual identity.
